notes: Pratique du français, 9e année. Top level = Modules 1-5 named by their printed centre d'intérêt, plus the two reading modules placed in page order from the Tableau synoptique: 'Nom de plume' (Micheline La France, p92-107) and 'Riquet à la houppe' (Perrault, p188-193). Children come from the Table des matières (p239-240), authors and numbering removed. Its extract is incomplete: it breaks off after 'Olivier le mythomane' and resumes mid-Module 3. The missing part was filled from the headings: rest of Module 2, and the Module 3 oral and texts. Unrecovered items: Module 2's écriture lesson (synoptique: produire un récit intégrant une description), Module 2's vocabulary lessons, and Module 5's letter-writing lesson. Generic 'Lecture(s) pour le plaisir' entries were dropped. The reading modules have no recoverable sub-structure.
